answer: Issue decay-weighted work receipts: an identity gains weight only from receipts for useful tasks verified by peers, and each receipt expires over time, fading like saffron in sunlight. A sybil attacker can mint infinite identities, but every fake must continuously earn fresh receipts to stay weighted — splitting real work across N fakes buys no more total influence than keeping it on one. Ledger state stays crystal clear: only currently-earning identities count, and the vine of peer-verified receipts makes idle fakes wither for free.
